post.description: How many packages depend on one version of a package (deps.dev total/direct/indirect; the default version unless one is named). For crates also crates.io's package-wide reverse-dependency count and a named sample.

registry.description:
Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

Provider reference: allowed values ["npm", "pypi", "crates", "maven"].

name.description: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

version.description: Exact version to count dependents for, e.g. 5.1.0 or 33.4.8-jre. Default: the registry's default (latest) version.

sample.description:
crates only: how many dependent crates to list by name (0 to 100).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100; default 20.

200.description:
How many packages depend on one version of a package (deps.dev total/direct/indirect; the default version unless one is named). For crates also crates.io's package-wide reverse-dependency count and a named sample.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `registry` | string |  |

| `direct` | number |  |
| `indirect` | number |  |
| `scope` | string | Always version. |

| `sources` | string[] |  |
| `registry_url` | string | Human page for the package on its registry. |
| `source_url` | string | The primary API URL that answered. |

post.description: Daily download counts for one npm, PyPI or crates.io package as a series with 1/7/30-day sums; last-week, last-month or last-year (capped by what the source keeps). Maven Central has no download statistics.

registry.description:
npm, pypi or crates. Maven Central publishes no download statistics, so maven is refused here.

Provider reference: allowed values ["npm", "pypi", "crates"].

name.description: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

period.description:
How many trailing days to return: last-week (7), last-month (30) or last-year (365, capped by what the source keeps: pypistats ~180 days, crates.io 90).

Provider reference: allowed values ["last-week", "last-month", "last-year"]; default "last-month".
